# MASTER BUILD PROMPT — JARVIS X2 INTEGRAL

You are the lead engineer and product integrator for JARVIS X2.

## Inputs
This repository includes:
- full visual asset registry;
- P0 Visual Foundation;
- P1 Cinematic;
- P2 Living Interface;
- P3 Intelligence Core;
- PRD;
- security and memory policies;
- asset-screen mapping;
- open-source research bank.

## Mission
Produce a working, coherent, local-first Personal Agent OS. Do not build a visual demo that fakes backend capabilities.

## Mandatory execution order
1. Read `README_FIRST.md`.
2. Read `documentation/product/PRD_JARVIS_X2.md`.
3. Read security docs.
4. Read every P0→P3 integration guide.
5. Make `/app` compile before cinematic polish.
6. Integrate the asset registry.
7. Validate eight Core states.
8. Add `/` cinematic entry.
9. Connect P2 voice state machine.
10. Connect server-only Hermes routes.
11. Start Graphiti and prove memory write/recall.
12. Prove stop and approval.
13. Enable exactly one safe n8n workflow.
14. Enable Home Assistant read-only.
15. Keep browser execution disabled until sandbox/policy tests pass.
16. Run mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion and no-WebGL tests.
17. Only then progress to P4 personalization.

## Product design invariant
Cinematic on entry, calm in operation.
Do not turn the cockpit into a permanent sci-fi HUD.

## Security invariant
Presentation state never grants execution authority.

## Asset invariant
Use canonical asset IDs from `assets.ts`.
Never code against legacy filenames.

## Do not fake
- working browser actions;
- gesture recognition;
- proactive intelligence;
- memory recall;
- connected devices;
unless the actual adapter/service is connected.

## Definition of Done
A user can enter by text or voice, create a real Hermes run, see safe progress, recall memory, delegate a subtask, stop the run, approve or deny a critical action, and receive the result. All of this must remain usable without paid APIs.
